definitions.explanation: A child of one's aunt or uncle.

examples.japanese: いとこ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}びに→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
いとこ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
いとこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：02084_shusseki⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧いとこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まりに→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I often went to stay at my cousin's house.

notes:
いとこ refers to a cousin regardless of gender or relative age. In everyday speech, the word is gender-neutral and almost always written in hiragana.

KANJI VARIATIONS:
Different kanji specify the cousin's gender and relative age:
- {従兄|いとこ}: older male cousin
- {従姉|いとこ}: older female cousin
- {従弟|いとこ}: younger male cousin
- {従妹|いとこ}: younger female cousin
- {従兄弟|いとこ}: male cousins (general)
- {従姉妹|いとこ}: female cousins (general)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いとこ⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧: between cousins
- いとこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: cousin's child

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦はとこ→はとこ：noentry⟧ (⟦{再従兄弟|はとこ}→再従兄弟：noentry⟧): second cousin
- ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧: relative (broader term)
